io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.description: The hubs are the records; A2A-Passport.ai issues the passport. Issued live from the GSC hubs, stamped every week. A2A Passport is operated by GreenCore Solutions Corp.: one signed document per product (a Global Trade Item Number, GTIN) or retail banner, composed live from the GSC hubs — A2A Grocery, A2A Cosmetics, A2A Peptides, A2A Retailmedia and the compliance records — and signed (EdDSA). Three tools: get_passport, list_passports, verify_passport. Every field is a hub's answer, word for word, with the door and the time it was read, or it is absent with a note: the passport never infers. A product no hub holds gets no passport. Reads are open; a verified, countersigned copy settles by x402. Artificial intelligence makes mistakes. A2A Passport is an agentic information source, not a recommendation. No ads, ever.
